verdict.rationale: Choosing where data is stored is a fair question for a cloud communications SaaS like Dialpad, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions region selection, data residency, or storage location. The PII anonymization and recording-removal endpoints are data-deletion controls, an adjacent feature that does not count toward residency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
